description: Source code for SoundDoseManager class managing audio sound dose and CSD (Cumulative Sound Dose) calculations, including interfacing with HAL, processing MEL (Mel-frequency) data, and handling callbacks.

classes.name: SoundDose
classes.description: Inner class implementing ISoundDose interface, providing methods for sound dose control and callback handling.

classes.name: HalSoundDoseCallback
classes.description: Callback class for HAL sound dose events, such as exposure warnings and MEL value updates.

methods.name: getOrCreateProcessorForDevice
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a MEL processor for a specific device and stream.

methods.name: setHalSoundDoseInterface
methods.description: Sets the HAL sound dose interface and registers callback.

methods.name: setOutputRs2UpperBound
methods.description: Sets the upper bound for RS2 (exposure level) either via HAL or internal processors.

methods.name: removeStreamProcessor
methods.description: Removes a stream's MEL processor based on stream handle.

methods.name: getIdForAudioDevice
methods.description: Retrieves the internal device ID for a given AudioDevice.

methods.name: mapAddressToDeviceId
methods.description: Maps an AudioDevice address to a device ID.

methods.name: clearMapDeviceIdEntries
methods.description: Clears mappings for a specific device ID.

methods.name: onMomentaryExposureWarning
methods.description: Handles exposure warning callbacks from HAL.

methods.name: onNewMelValues
methods.description: Processes new MEL values, updates CSD, and triggers callbacks.

methods.name: onMomentaryExposure
methods.description: Triggers momentary exposure callback for a device.

methods.name: getSoundDoseInterface
methods.description: Provides the ISoundDose interface with callback registration.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Returns a string dump of current CSD and MEL records.

methods.name: getCachedMelRecordsSize
methods.description: Returns the number of cached MEL records.

methods.name: csdRecordToSoundDoseRecord
methods.description: Converts internal CSD record to external SoundDoseRecord format.
